exam.title: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer - Associate
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with about one year deploying, managing, and operating workloads. Practice console/CLI, scripting, operating systems, containers, CI/CD, IaC, monitoring/logging, networking, security, multi-account operations, incident response, backup/recovery and performance/cost troubleshooting.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Monitoring, Logging, Analysis, Remediation, and Performance Optimization

review.notes: The current five-domain SOA-C03 blueprint, detailed domain pages, in-scope service list, comparison appendix and live certification page were reconciled on September 1, 2026. The guide explicitly separates SOA-C03 from the retired six-domain SOA-C02 blueprint and covers the newer CloudOps name plus containers, multi-account and multi-Region operations, CDK, Terraform and Git, Kiro, AWS DevOps Agent, AWS Security Agent and Amazon S3 Files scope. Three scenarios, eight safe labs and 40 original checks cover evidence-chain troubleshooting; observability, remediation and performance; scaling, availability, backup and disaster recovery; images, IaC, deployments and automation; identity, encryption, findings and compliance evidence; and VPC, DNS, edge and network diagnosis. All 26 guide URLs are cataloged: 24 reachable and O'Reilly/Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Volatile product and learning metadata is labeled, and no recalled exam questions are used. September 17, 2026 delivery maintenance: checked the live AWS certification page and added the applicable language retirement or replacement-exam notice, including conflicting vendor dates where present. Existing objective snapshot and full-review dates remain unchanged. See docs/research/2026-09-17-exam-validation.md.
